resources.title: I Got To Play GAMBIT Early! (Combos, Tips And Ability Breakdown)
resources.creator: Necros
resources.noteEs: Necros desglosa el kit de Gambit con acceso temprano: combos, uso de cada habilidad y como sacarle valor. Si quieres aprender al strategist desde su llegada, este es el punto de partida.
resources.noteEn: Necros breaks down Gambit's kit from early access: combos, how each ability works and how to extract value. If you want to learn the strategist from launch, this is the starting point.

resources.title: ULTIMATE Marvel Rivals Spider-Man Guide: Combos, Tech, Matchups and more! (Season 5 And Beyond!)
resources.creator: Dash SK
resources.noteEs: Spider-Man es el duelist con mayor skill cap del juego. Esta guia cubre combos, tech de movimiento y matchups, actualizada para Season 5 y posteriores. Para quien quiera dominar al heroe mas mecanico.
resources.noteEn: Spider-Man is the highest skill-cap duelist in the game. This guide covers combos, movement tech and matchups, updated for Season 5 and beyond. For anyone aiming to master the most mechanical hero.

resources.title: Thor Guide | The BEST Comprehensive Guide to THOR in Marvel Rivals
resources.creator: Paz
resources.noteEs: Guia integral del vanguard Thor actualizada tras varios cambios de balance: gestion de su recurso, agresion segura y como liderar la frontline. Recomendada para quien quiera tankear con presion ofensiva.
resources.noteEn: A comprehensive guide to the Thor vanguard, updated after several balance changes: resource management, safe aggression and how to lead the frontline. Recommended for anyone wanting to tank with offensive pressure.

resources.title: Learn To Play Mantis - Marvel Rivals Strategist Guide
resources.creator: Kublizee
resources.noteEs: Guia de la strategist Mantis: como sembrar y gastar sus energias, priorizar curaciones y aprovechar su boost de dano. Evergreen para entender a una de las soportes mas completas del roster.
resources.noteEn: A guide to the Mantis strategist: how to bank and spend her energy, prioritize heals and leverage her damage boost. Evergreen for understanding one of the most complete supports on the roster.

resources.title: Daredevil Best Crosshair, Settings, And Combo Tips | Marvel Rivals
resources.creator: Marvel Rivals Merchant
resources.noteEs: Guia concentrada de Daredevil: crosshair, settings y los combos clave para sacarle el maximo. Formato corto y al grano, ideal para aprender al heroe en una sentada.
resources.noteEn: A focused Daredevil guide: crosshair, settings and the key combos to get the most out of him. Short, to-the-point format, ideal for learning the hero in one sitting.
